Name: Elah, Son of Caleb
Summary: Son of Caleb son of Jephunneh and father of Kenaz.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:15: Son of Caleb son of Jephunneh and father of Kenaz.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Elah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
